title: inconsistency-sheaf
description: The cokernel of the inclusion of the truth-side settling-associated sheaf into the paraconsistent settling-associated sheaf, the free abelian group on newly-added top-valued ('told both') cells alone. It is the sheaf refinement that isolates the paraconsistent-evidence content of a knowledge presheaf settling.

sections.description: F_U^{(top)}(q, tau, U) := Z^{Delta^{+,*,top}_tau(q) cap U}, the free abelian group on the newly-added top-valued cells lying in the pairwise-Stone clopen U

tracksTopCellsOnly.description: isolates the top-only summand Delta^{+,top}_tau(q) of the newly-added designated cells, the contradictory ('told both') evidence, treated as designated rather than as logical collapse

cokernel.description: arises as the cokernel of F_U hookrightarrow F_U^{(k)}; equivalently the F_U^{(top)} summand of the splitting F_U^{(k)} cong F_U^{(t)} oplus F_U^{(top)}

vanishesWhenConsistent.description: F_U^{(top)} = 0 identically for a consistent knowledge presheaf that never produces top-cells; non-zero exactly when the presheaf is inconsistent
